About the job:

    We are looking for a Client Relationship Manager to join our Client Relations team in Hong Kong. You will be the main point of contact for our business clients in the region: you will onboard new clients, look after a growing portfolio, and help clients use more of Unlimit's payment and card account services. You will work closely with our Compliance, AML and Sales teams. The position plays a crucial part in driving client satisfaction and business development.

What you will do:

  • Client relationships and growth: understand each client's business model and funds flow, build long-term relationships, and grow turnover through upselling and cross-selling our products.
  • New clients and partners: bring in new business clients across APAC and build relationships with partners who introduce clients to us.
  • Onboarding and due diligence: guide clients through account opening, collect and review KYC/KYB documents, and carry out the initial risk assessment in line with our policies.
  • Ongoing monitoring: collect the information our AML team needs for transaction monitoring and periodic reviews, and keep client files up to date.
  • Day-to-day service: handle client requests and complaints, card-related issues, account changes and closures; issue reference letters, account certificates and statements; keep clients informed of changes to fees, terms and holiday schedules.
  • Product feedback: share what clients need to help us improve our products and processes. 
     

What we are looking for:

  • 3+ years in relationship management, client onboarding or account management at a bank, EMI, payment company or virtual bank, with hands-on corporate KYC/KYB experience.
  • Good understanding of AML and due diligence requirements for business clients, including higher-risk industries such as e-commerce, gaming, crypto and fintech.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken. Cantonese and/or Mandarin is a strong advantage.
  • University degree in Economics, Law, Business Administration or a related field.
  • Well organised and able to handle many client requests at once; experience with CRM or ticketing tools.
  • Right to work in Hong Kong. This role is based in our Hong Kong office (no remote work).

What we offer:

  • Competitive monthly salary in line with your experience
  • Annual leave, sick leave and paid public holidays
  • Full-time, Monday to Friday
  • Modern office in Hong Kong with all the equipment you need
  • An international team of professionals to learn from, and clients across APAC

Join Unlimit Team now!
 
Unlimit is an equal opportunity employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.

Crypto.com is looking for a Compliance Manager to lead and strengthen our U.S. consumer compliance program and exchange operations. This is a high-ownership, hands-on role built for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments and brings deep experience in consumer protection laws, Regulation E, and UDAAP compliance. About the Role

Crypto.com is looking for a Compliance Manager to lead and strengthen our U.S. consumer compliance program and exchange operations. This is a high-ownership, hands-on role built for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments and brings deep experience in consumer protection laws, Regulation E, and UDAAP compliance. While supporting broader regulatory initiatives and BSA/AML program alignment, your primary focus will be designing, auditing, and executing consumer compliance controls across our product offerings (including credit, prepaid, and digital asset transactions).

Responsibilities

  • Own and maintain the U.S. Consumer Compliance framework, serving as the subject matter expert on Reg E (EFTs, error resolution, unauthorized transfers, chargebacks, notice disclosures) and UDAAP risk mitigation across all products.
  • Conduct ongoing compliance reviews of consumer-facing flows, terms of service, disclosures, promotional materials, and product features to identify and prevent potential UDAAP issues.
  • Oversee and enhance Reg E error resolution timelines, root-cause analysis for consumer complaints, and chargeback compliance mechanisms.
  • Lead preparations for consumer compliance examinations and audits; manage project plans, scoping, timelines, and deliverables for regulatory remediation efforts.
  • Own, update, and operationalize consumer compliance policies, ensuring alignment with evolving federal (CFPB, FTC, OCC/FDIC standards) and state regulations.
  • Partner with product, operations, legal, and customer support teams to integrate consumer protection controls into product rollouts and customer communication (RFI) workflows.
  • Provide secondary support for broader compliance program initiatives, including BSA/AML policy alignment, executive committee reporting, and ad hoc regulatory submissions.
  • Perform ad hoc special projects as required

Requirements

  • 3+ years of compliance experience in a financial services, fintech, or banking environment
  • Demonstrated subject matter expertise in Reg E (electronic fund transfers, error resolution procedures, prepaid card rules, and credit card compliance) and UDAAP risk frameworks.
  • Direct experience managing consumer complaint trends, conducting UDAAP risk assessments, and refining consumer-facing operational processes.
  • Proven track record supporting regulatory examinations, internal audits, and executing formal regulatory remediation plans.
  • Working knowledge of broader financial regulatory frameworks, including BSA/AML and state-level consumer protection statutes.
  • Experience collaborating with product, customer operations, and engineering teams to implement regulatory requirements into workflows.
  • Comfort operating with autonomy in a fast-paced environment where procedures may need to be built from scratch.
  • Familiarity with banking regulators and examination processes is a plus

Senior Product Manager, Cyber Intelligence

Location: Tel Aviv, Israel


At Chainalysis, we build products that help organizations connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Our data and solutions have supported some of the world’s most high-profile criminal investigations and help grow access to cryptocurrency safely.


About the role

Intelligence Collection works with researchers, data scientists, engineers, and intelligence analysts to build and deliver actionable intelligence. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Cyber Intelligence collection and build products that reveal the cyber infrastructure behind threat actors operating onchain and offchain. This intelligence helps public-sector customers disrupt ransomware operators, scam networks, sanctioned actors, terrorist financiers, and other threats.

You’ll connect raw collection to customer-ready intelligence: expanding coverage and confidence, bringing new data into Reactor and Data Solutions, and shaping products that help customers assess risk. You’ll work closely with technical teams and investigators, as well as Sales, Legal, Solutions Architecture, Product Marketing, and other partners, to take promising research from experiment to production and into the market.


In this role, you’ll

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and requirements for Cyber Intelligence across threat categories.

  • Partner with engineering to build and improve cyber collection infrastructure. Measure the yield and quality of collection techniques and sources, identify coverage gaps, and prioritize where to expand.

  • Work with researchers and data scientists to turn cyber indicators into reliable, explainable intelligence, with confidence calibrated for each technique.

  • Connect threat-actor attributions to the infrastructure behind them—including hosting, servers, certificates, applications, and tracking fingerprints—and help reveal relationships between operators and their networks.

  • Bring new intelligence into Reactor, Data Solutions, and other products so investigators can use it in their workflows; explore customer-facing products for cyber-intelligence risk screening.

  • Design experiments with engineering and research teams, and guide promising approaches into production. Evaluate external data partners and determine where they can strengthen our capabilities.

  • Work with investigators and go-to-market partners to understand customer needs, communicate the value and limitations of different intelligence types, and bring products to market.

  • Define product telemetry, success measures, and operating rhythms that improve intelligence coverage, quality, customer impact, and business outcomes.


We’re looking for candidates who have

  • 6+ years of professional experience, including 4+ years in product management.

  • A track record of taking data, machine learning, or intelligence products from concept to production, including evaluating probabilistic or statistical outputs and making them useful to end users.

  • Experience with data products, machine learning, or intelligence, and a strong understanding of precision, recall, calibration, and the impact of false positives on investigators.

  • The ability to use SQL and Python to explore large datasets and engage with data scientists on research results and technical trade-offs.

  • Strong product judgment and a bias for action: you can test and iterate quickly, decide when to productionize or stop an approach, and make trade-offs clear.

  • A record of delivering measurable outcomes, setting meaningful success metrics, and leading work across teams without direct authority.

  • Excellent written communication and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear plans for technical teams, while explaining complex methods and product value to different audiences.

  • A customer-focused, high-ownership approach: you learn directly from users, take responsibility for outcomes end to end, and use what you learn to set priorities.


You might also have

  • A deep understanding of internet infrastructure and how threat actors use or obscure it, including routing, DNS, cloud and CDN hosting, proxies, or anonymization services.

  • Experience in cyber threat intelligence, network security, offensive cyber, or government intelligence.

  • Experience with blockchain analytics or cryptocurrency investigations.

  • Experience launching enterprise data products with usage-based or consumption pricing.

  • Previous experience as a data scientist, researcher, software engineer, or intelligence analyst.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Financial Connections helps people securely share their financial data with the businesses they choose. Developers use it to build products that help people understand and manage their money. We’re expanding what’s possible with that data as AI creates new ways for people to interact with their finances, from making sense of everyday spending to getting personalized answers to financial questions.

We bring together Stripe’s financial infrastructure and developer ecosystem with Link, our consumer network, to help businesses build the next generation of financial products.

What you’ll do

You’ll build and grow Financial Connections’ next generation of financial data products, with a focus on AI-powered experiences. This is an opportunity to shape an emerging business at Stripe: identify the customer problems worth solving, turn early ideas into products, and build demand for them.

You’ll work directly with customers, from fintech companies to businesses building with AI, and own the journey from the first product conversations through launch and sustained adoption. You’ll have room to define the direction, experiment, and build, with Stripe’s infrastructure and customer relationships behind you. We’re looking for someone who is as excited to win an early customer as they are to shape a long-term product vision.

Responsibilities

  • Set the vision and strategy for new financial data products, identifying where Stripe can solve valuable customer problems and build a differentiated business.
  • Spend time with developers and customers to understand their needs, test ideas, and decide which opportunities to pursue.
  • Partner with Engineering and Design to turn ambiguous opportunities into simple, high-quality products, moving quickly while earning users’ trust.
  • Work directly with early customers to help them launch, learn what makes the product valuable, and use that feedback to improve it.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Partnerships to bring products to market and turn early customer successes into broader adoption.
  • Define success and use customer feedback, usage, and retention to decide where to invest, iterate, or change direction.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 6+ years of product management or product-focused founder experience
  • A track record of launching and growing new products for businesses, with ownership from customer discovery through adoption.
  • Strong product judgment and creativity, with the ability to turn an open-ended problem into a clear direction and make progress with incomplete information.
  • A hands-on approach to building a business. You’re comfortable pitching early customers, working through obstacles, and changing your approach as you learn.
  • Experience partnering closely with engineers on technical products, with a high bar for product quality and the ability to make complex experiences feel simple.
  • Strong analytical skills and clear written and verbal communication. You can use data and customer insights to make decisions and explain your reasoning.
  • Experience leading work across teams and external partners, with the autonomy, persistence, and attention to detail to see it through.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with financial products, data platforms, or products that use AI.
  • Experience building in an early-stage environment and scaling products within a larger organization.
  • Experience developing products that serve both businesses and their end users.
descriptions.job-11212ue:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

We’re looking for a Senior Recruiting Coordinator to deliver an exceptional candidate and interviewer experience and help lead the day-to-day work of our global coordination team. You’ll own complex interview scheduling, bring deep Ashby expertise, use metrics to improve performance, and mentor fellow coordinators. You’ll also manage the day-to-day work of the AI agents we’re building to support recruiting coordination.

Partnering closely with Talent Operations, you’ll improve how our people, systems, and AI agents work together. This is a hands-on role for someone who communicates proactively, brings solutions, and moves with urgency, with opportunities to grow into people management over time.

The impact you will have:

  • Own complex interview scheduling across teams and time zones, delivering a responsive, well-organized experience for candidates and interviewers.

  • Serve as the team’s Ashby expert, resolving scheduling issues, coaching coordinators, and partnering with Talent Operations to improve workflows.

  • Own day-to-day coordination operations and support Talent Operations projects, keeping Ashby records, interview plans, and scheduling data accurate and up to date.

  • Drive coordination performance through accurate reporting on interview volume, time to schedule, SLA adherence, reschedules, and candidate and interviewer feedback.

  • Develop fellow coordinators through onboarding, training, and practical coaching, helping the team manage priorities, workloads, and coverage.

  • Manage AI agents that support recruiting coordination, reviewing their work, resolving exceptions, and improving their accuracy and reliability with Talent Operations.

  • Partner closely with recruiters and the Talent team, aligning on priorities, communicating risks early, and bringing clear recommendations that keep interviews moving.

What we’re looking for:

  • 4+ years of recruiting coordination experience, with demonstrated success managing complex, high-volume scheduling in a fast-moving environment.

  • Advanced Ashby expertise is required, including interview plans, interviewer pools, scheduling links, calendar integrations, and independent troubleshooting.

  • Experience supporting Talent Operations or coordination operations, including ATS data quality, workflow maintenance, and process documentation.

  • Strong command of Ashby reporting and coordination metrics, with a track record of translating data into better scheduling outcomes.

  • Experience mentoring coordinators, leading training, and helping teammates use Ashby confidently and effectively.

  • Clear, proactive communication and the ability to build trusted partnerships with candidates, interviewers, recruiters, and Talent Operations.

  • Sound judgment and a strong sense of urgency: you investigate problems, recommend solutions, and follow through without repeated direction.

  • Applied AI fluency, including writing instructions, evaluating outputs, and identifying when human judgment is needed. Experience managing AI agents is a strong plus.

About the Team:

  • Our talent team is fully remote, embracing async communication and collaboration through Slack channels, thorough documentation, and proactive updates to keep work moving forward smoothly across time zones.

  • We hold weekly RC team syncs to review priorities and solve coordination challenges. Coordinators also participate in hiring syncs for the roles they support, staying close to candidate progress, hiring decisions, and upcoming needs.

  • Driven by a dedication to our craft, we continuously refine our best practices and data quality to deliver an exceptional experience for both internal stakeholders and candidates, supported by precise, reliable reporting.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Based in the Pacific Time Zone, working 8:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m. PT.

  • As a globally distributed team, we operate across various time zones, yet most of us overlap for collaboration and meetings between 7 a.m.–12 p.m. PT.

  • An active scheduling workload alongside coordination operations, Ashby data maintenance, mentoring, reporting, and AI agent oversight.

  • Advance coverage planning for holidays and absences, with clear owners and next steps.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • When an interviewer cancels, you promptly identify alternatives, recommend a solution, and confirm the revised plan with the candidate and interview team.

  • When scheduling misses turnaround targets, you use Ashby data to diagnose the issue, recommend a change, and track whether performance improves.

  • When an AI agent sends incomplete instructions, you correct the affected communications and partner with Talent Operations to test a fix.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.
descriptions.job-02fb5t2:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 

The opportunity

Great creative starts with a sharp idea, and the earlier it arrives, the better the work gets. As our Creative Strategist & Producer, you bring ideas in at the start of a campaign and you can also make them. Up to half the role is writing complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, and sometimes organic and social, then briefing them into our creatives and designers. The other half is making work yourself, in whatever format you’re strongest at. You also help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing write stronger briefs of their own.

This role is for a proactive self-starter. Nobody will hand you the idea: you go and find it, pitch it and get it made.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You work daily with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, who bring deep knowledge of the product and the media channels, and with the creatives who bring your briefs to life.

 

  • Spot opportunities in culture every day. Watch pop culture, trends, competitors, comments and performance data, and turn what you find into ideas we ship the same week. Stay close to financial markets and to Kraken’s audience.

  • Write complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, built with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, and brief them into the performance creatives and designers.

  • Help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing managers sharpen their own briefs, bringing the concept, the hook and the cultural angle to the start of the process.

  • Pitch original concepts for paid and social before anyone asks, so ideas reach the team already sharp.

  • Make your own content for paid and organic. The format is open: you could be a meme machine, an AI video specialist, someone who performs to camera, or something we haven’t thought of. What matters is that it feels native to the feed and ships fast.

  • Use performance data and social listening as creative input, and get more distinct angles into tests each month.Performance Marketing owns test design and readouts; you own the creative response.

  • React inside the news cycle. You spot the moment, and you brief it or make it yourself.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and compliance to get work approved without losing the idea.

  • Keep your briefs and files clean enough for other people to build on.

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years in creative strategy, social, content or performance creative at a high-volume in-house team, brand or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

  • A portfolio submitted with your application.   • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage
